novel.justification: This proposal-specific restriction isolates the genuinely multi-arm response geometry: with at least three active coordinates, \(\ker(c^\top)\subset\mathbb R^{S_c}\) has dimension at least two, so the response tube has multiple transverse directions absent from the normalized two-arm experiment. Prespecified regimen-versus-average contrasts in four-arm trials, including an ACTG-175-style comparison, satisfy the restriction.
